_readme: Previous-year IBPS PO Prelims papers. IBPS does not publish official question papers, so every paper here is a memory-based reconstruction. Set `source` honestly on each paper — it is shown to the user in the UI.

papers.name: Display name, e.g. IBPS PO Prelims 2024 — Shift 1
papers.note: Optional line shown under the paper name

questions.section: English Language | Quantitative Aptitude | Reasoning Ability
questions.marks: number — leave out and it is filled from SECTION_PLAN
questions.negativeMarks: number — leave out and it is filled from SECTION_PLAN
questions.question: stem
questions.passage: shared passage/clue block on the FIRST question of a set, else null

papers.name: IBPS PO Prelims 2025 — Shift 1
